site.title: The Week After Christmas
site.subtitle: Four places that work for all ten of us. Sunday December 27, 2026 to Sunday January 3, 2027.
site.disclaimer: Preliminary. Nothing is booked, quoted or decided. Every price is an estimate for ten people at holiday-week rates unless it says published. Flight days are as the airlines announced them and still need to be checked for these dates.
site.party: Mom, Patrick and Sara, Andrew and Trisha, Kristina and Michael with Bennett (7) and Taylor (3), and Daniel. Seven fly from Norfolk, two from Richmond, one from Austin.
rules: One roof, a bedroom for each couple, Mom, Daniel and the kids: six doors, or five plus a real bunk room.
A base you can walk out of: a safe town with things to do on foot, and cars for the group. No compound.
Mom's rule: a nice place to stay and walking options, one anchor a day, split up for specific things and reconvene for dinner.

Food: Sara is gluten-free at celiac level and eats real butter, dairy, eggs and meat. Kristina has a tree-nut allergy. Mom is pescatarian. Every option runs on a house kitchen plus one or two chef nights.
The adventure crew (Patrick, Daniel, Andrew, Mom, Kristina) and the relaxed crew (Sara, Trisha, Michael, the kids) each get a real week, in parallel, from the same house.

trips.name: Puerto Rico
trips.place: Rincón, with Old San Juan at each end
trips.pitch: A pool house in Rincón, a surf town you walk around, with a night in Old San Juan on the way in and the way out so nobody drives the west side in the dark with Taylor. No passports, nonstops from Norfolk and Richmond, US medicine, sea level, real winter surf and a boat dive for the crew, pool and the calm side of the beach for the kids.
why: US soil: no passports, US hospitals and pharmacies, dollars, phones that just work.
JetBlue announced a Sunday nonstop from Norfolk and a Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday nonstop from Richmond. Daniel connects once from Austin.
Real adventure from the door: December surf at Maria's, Domes and Sandy Beach, a two-tank boat dive at Desecheo Island, the Gozalandia waterfall, an Isabela surf day.
Old San Juan on foot at each end: El Morro, the walls, a good dinner.
The cheapest warm option on the list.
catch: December is big-wave season, so the kids stay on the pool and the calm-side beaches, and reef snorkeling is a summer thing.
Gluten-free restaurants are thin. Most meals are at the house, with a chef for two nights.
The best six-bedroom house found is about a mile from the plaza. The one that is an easy walk to town has five bedrooms.
The Norfolk nonstop does not fly Saturdays, and its clock times still need to be confirmed on jetblue.com.
Rincón has no hospital. The nearest ER, with a separate one for kids, is in Aguadilla, about 25 to 30 minutes away.
trips.weather: Dry-season tropics: highs in the mid-80s, lows around 70, brief trade-wind showers, sea about 80 degrees. Winter swell on the west coast.

getting_there.how: JetBlue nonstop to San Juan, announced for Mon, Wed, Fri and Sun (flight 929 out, 928 back). Sunday Dec 27 out and Sunday Jan 3 back fit the pattern; Mon Dec 28 and Mon Jan 4 are the fallbacks. About 3.5 hours in the air.

JetBlue nonstop Tue, Thu and Sat only, so Andrew and Trisha drive to Norfolk and fly with the group, or fly Sat Dec 26 and Sat Jan 2 with an extra San Juan night, or connect once via Charlotte or Atlanta on the Sundays.
One stop via Charlotte, Dallas, Atlanta or Houston. Southwest's seasonal Austin to San Juan nonstop is unconfirmed for the holiday window.
Two seven-seat vehicles for the week. San Juan to Rincón is about 2.5 hours, done in daylight both ways.

houses.name: Casa Cooky, Corcega side
houses.detail: Six bedrooms as three two-bedroom suites, 6.5 baths. The whole property is fenced with privacy walls and a code-gated private pool. Steps from the beach; the plaza is about a mile down the road. Air conditioning in the bedrooms only.
houses.verdict: Best fence and six doors. Quote first.

houses.name: Maria's Luxury Villa, Maria's Beach
houses.detail: Eight bedrooms, two full kitchens, a full-size pool and two hot tubs, a generator and Starlink. Gated oceanfront on a surf break, so the kids use the pool.
houses.price: Published $2,350 a night in high season with a six-night holiday minimum, taxes and housekeeping included, about $14,100 for Dec 28 to Jan 3
houses.verdict: Strongest house systems and the only published rate. Quote second.

houses.name: Ensenada five-bedroom, near Puntas
houses.detail: Five bedrooms including a double-plus-bunk room for the kids, a main-level bedroom with a full bath for Mom, gated and walled, private pool, backup generator. The listing calls the plaza an easy walk.
houses.verdict: The walk-to-town house. Five doors, so the kids share with Kristina and Michael.

houses.name: Rincón Beach House at Sandy Beach, Puntas
houses.detail: Six bedrooms in two units with two kitchens, whole-home generators and solar, a private pool, a minute's walk to Sandy Beach. About 15 minutes by car to the plaza.
houses.price: About $890 to $1,030 a night off-peak; holiday rate unknown
houses.verdict: Six doors in the surf pocket. A car to town.

agenda.all: Fly in. Sleep in Old San Juan. Dinner in the old city.
Drive west in daylight with a grocery stop. Villa by early afternoon. Pool, then sunset at the Punta Higuera lighthouse.
Dinner at the house.
agenda.crew: Dawn surf at Maria's or Domes. Lessons at the Marina for Andrew, Daniel and Kristina.
agenda.relax: Corcega shallows, pool, a long lunch, the town on foot.

agenda.all: First chef night.
agenda.crew: Desecheo two-tank boat dive for Mom and the certified divers, seas permitting. Patrick snorkels or fishes.
agenda.relax: Massage at the house. Sara's Pilates if the studio checks out. Kids in the pool.

agenda.all: Gozalandia waterfall in the morning, about an hour away, splash pool for the kids, picnic. Kids' dinner early, New Year's Eve chef dinner on the terrace.
Nothing scheduled. Pool, cards, a lighthouse walk. Snorkel at Steps only if the sea is flat.
agenda.relax: Sunset beach horseback ride with Bennett and Mom.

agenda.all: Drive east. Old San Juan on foot: El Morro, the walls, dinner. Hotel night.
Morning flights home. Andrew and Trisha can take the Saturday Richmond nonstop the day before.

trips.name: Anna Maria Island
trips.tag: Easiest for the spouses and kids
trips.pitch: A pool house a short walk from the Gulf on a bike-everywhere island with walkable villages. The easiest flights on the list and the best week for the spouses and the kids. The crew gets a manatee morning, a boat day and bikes, not surf or snow.
why: About six hours door to door: Breeze flies Norfolk to Tampa nonstop, Richmond has had the same, and Austin has nonstops to Tampa.
Beach and pool every day for a three-year-old, bikes for a seven-year-old, Pine Avenue and Bridge Street for the adults.
Sarasota and St. Petersburg are 30 to 60 minutes away: the Ringling, Selby Gardens' holiday lights, the Chihuly Collection (Mom's September trip, continued), the Mote aquarium.
Crystal River manatee snorkel in peak season, a boat day to Egmont Key, mangrove paddles.
catch: The thinnest week for the adventure crew. The Gulf is usually flat in December.
Gulf water runs mid to upper sixties, so the pool carries the swimming.
The flagship listing has five true bedrooms plus a den with a bunk and trundle; confirm a real sixth room.
Holiday-week availability on the island is the real question this late. Published peak rates for six-bedroom houses run $1,755 to $2,251 a night before taxes and fees.
One celiac-aware restaurant on the island (The Waterfront, a single undated review). Most meals at the house, with a chef for New Year's Eve.
trips.weather: Highs around 70 to 75, lows in the 50s, Gulf water in the high 60s. Beach and pool weather most days; a cold front can bring wind.

getting_there.how: Breeze Airways nonstop to Tampa, about 2 hours 15 minutes, then about 1 hour 15 minutes by car to Holmes Beach. Frontier is seasonal.
Breeze nonstop to Tampa on last year's schedule, or Sarasota via Breeze; confirm the December days.
Southwest or Delta nonstop to Tampa, about 3 daily on weekdays; Allegiant to Sarasota, 30 minutes from the island.
Two SUVs for the week, plus bikes on the island.

houses.name: Paradise Beach House, 403 42nd St, Holmes Beach
houses.detail: Three king masters, a queen room, a twin room and a den with a bunk and trundle, every bedroom en suite, heated pool, a short walk to the beach and shops.
houses.price: Estimate $2,000 to $3,500 a night for the holiday week, unquoted
houses.verdict: Five true bedrooms plus the den. Quote and ask about the den.

houses.name: Emerald Kite six-bedroom retreat, Holmes Beach
houses.detail: Six bedrooms, five baths, private pool.
houses.price: Published peak $1,755 a night before taxes and fees
houses.verdict: Six doors at the published peak rate.

houses.name: Emerald Kite luxury six-bedroom, Holmes Beach
houses.detail: Six bedrooms, four baths, private pool.
houses.price: Published peak $2,251 a night before taxes and fees
houses.verdict: Six doors; the pricier of the two.

agenda.all: Fly to Tampa, pick up the cars, Publix run, check in. Pool, then sunset at Bean Point.
Island day: bikes, the beach, Pine Avenue, lunch at The Waterfront.
agenda.relax: Sara's Pilates or a spa slot. Kids at the beach.

agenda.all: Dinner at the house.
agenda.crew: Dawn departure for the Crystal River manatee snorkel, back mid-afternoon.
agenda.relax: Mote SEA aquarium in Sarasota with the kids.

agenda.all: Sarasota together: the Ringling (art, Ca' d'Zan, the circus museum for Bennett), then Selby Gardens' Lights in Bloom after dark.
New Year's Eve chef dinner at the house.
agenda.crew: Half-day boat charter: fishing, dolphins, Egmont Key. Wing-foil or kite if a front brings wind.
agenda.relax: Beach, pool, spa. Mom's option: a plane checkout at Sarasota and a coastal flight.

agenda.all: Slow beach day. Patrick's family photos at golden hour.
St. Petersburg morning at the Chihuly Collection, waterfront lunch, back for sunset.
Checkout and the same nonstops home.

trips.name: Park City
trips.pitch: An Old Town house with Main Street and the Town Lift at the door. The best riding week by a mile and the best town to walk out into. It costs three things: a third winter trip in two years, 7,000 feet for Sara after Breckenridge, and a cold week for Michael, Trisha and the kids.
why: Park City Mountain from the Town Lift, a walk from the house, five or six riding days. Canyons Village on the same pass. A Big Cottonwood powder day for the crew.
Main Street: shops, galleries, restaurants, the free trolley, a hot tub at the house every night.
Utah Olympic Park and the Comet bobsled for Kristina, who has wanted to bobsled since Lake Placid (age rules to confirm).
The Viking Yurt sleigh-ride dinner for Mom: the music-with-dinner evening she writes up.
Daniel's easiest trip of any option: a nonstop from Austin to Salt Lake.
catch: A third winter trip in two years, against Mom's own note that not everyone snowboards.
Altitude: Old Town sits near 7,000 feet, and Sara was sick at Breckenridge.
A cold week for the relaxed crew, with highs in the 20s and 30s.
Peak-week pricing: a six-bedroom Old Town house over New Year's runs $35,000 to $55,000 for the week, before flights and lift tickets.
Luna's Kitchen is the only dedicated gluten-free kitchen in town, counter-service and closed Sundays; the two-kitchen house gives Sara her own kitchen.
trips.weather: Cold, dry, sunny days: highs in the 20s and 30s, lows in the teens. Snow depends on the year; December averages 30 to 65 inches depending on the source.

getting_there.how: One stop to Salt Lake City on Delta via Atlanta, or United via Denver or Washington. A nonstop may exist some days; check Dec 27 and Jan 3. Then 40 minutes to Old Town.
One stop via Atlanta, Denver or Washington.
Nonstop on Delta (three or four a day) or Southwest, about 3 hours.
Two AWD SUVs or a 12-passenger van. Groceries at Kimball Junction on the way in.

houses.name: Old Town, two kitchens, hot tub, 4 minutes to everything
houses.detail: Six bedrooms, five baths, sleeps 14: two kings, three queens and a twin room, two kitchens, a hot tub and a fireplace. A three-minute walk to Main Street and about 11 minutes on foot to the Town Lift.
houses.price: Estimate $2,500 to $3,800 a night, unquoted; verifiers put the week at $35,000 to $55,000
houses.verdict: The two kitchens solve Sara's food. Quote first. Likely the same house as the Airbnb listing below.

houses.name: Park City Retreat, private deck and hot tub
houses.detail: Six bedrooms, five baths, eight beds, sleeps 14, Old Town.
houses.verdict: Probably the same house on a second platform.

houses.name: Spacious Mountain Oasis 1060
houses.detail: Six bedrooms, sleeps 12, hot tub and an outdoor lounge.

agenda.all: Fly to Salt Lake (Daniel nonstop; Norfolk and Richmond via Atlanta). 40 minutes to Old Town, groceries at Kimball Junction, hot tub, a simple dinner at the house.
Family dinner at the house.
agenda.crew: Ride Park City Mountain from the Town Lift.
agenda.relax: Bennett and Taylor in ski school. Sara at Lagree, then lunch at Luna's Kitchen. Michael and Trisha walk Main Street.

agenda.all: Dinner out at Riverhorse on Main.
agenda.relax: Sledding at the house or a snow-play afternoon with the kids, then a spa afternoon.

agenda.all: Utah Olympic Park in the morning, Kristina's bobsled if the age and season rules allow. Adults at the Viking Yurt sleigh-ride dinner while Mom or a sitter has the kids.
Half-day riding, then the New Year's Eve chef dinner at the house and Main Street fireworks for whoever is awake.
Slow morning.
agenda.crew: The big day: a Big Cottonwood powder run, or a guided backcountry day for the brothers if cleared.
agenda.relax: Sara and Trisha Nordic or snowshoe. Kids skate. Mom's scenic-flight add-on.

agenda.all: Last laps for the crew, a Deer Valley morning for the skiers, pack.
Fly home.

trips.name: Asheville
trips.pitch: A six-bedroom house with a hot tub fifteen minutes from downtown, a seven-hour drive from Virginia Beach. Biltmore at Christmas, the Grove Park spa and gingerbread houses, a dedicated gluten-free restaurant that serves real food, and skiing at Cataloochee as a bonus, not a plan.
why: The cheapest option by a wide margin, and the safest and simplest: drive down, no airports for nine of the ten.
Biltmore's Candlelight Christmas Evening, Olmsted's gardens, the Grove Park Inn's National Gingerbread House display.
Posana downtown has been fully gluten-free since 2009 and serves steak, short rib and lobster gnocchi.
A hike-and-spa week for the crew, with Cataloochee or a Sugar Mountain day when the snowmaking holds, and Bent Creek or DuPont for bikes.
A fireplace, a hot tub and everyone under one roof: the lodging Mom praises most in her blog.
catch: Thin for the adventure crew. Cataloochee gets about 5 inches of natural snow in December and runs on snowmaking; a warm spell closes it.
Nobody in the family has pitched it.
Snow in town is unlikely; December runs a 51-degree high and a 31-degree low.
The heated pool at the lead house is a paid extra and unconfirmed for winter.
Daniel's Austin flight is a connection or a long drive; a seasonal Allegiant nonstop is unconfirmed for December.
trips.weather: December highs around 51, lows around 31, snow in town unlikely. The ski areas run on snowmaking and a warm week can shut them.

getting_there.how: Drive: about 430 miles, 8 to 9 hours with stops and a three-year-old. Flying is one stop via Charlotte to Asheville.
getting_there.est: $120 to $200 in gas per car, or $600 to $800 a seat to fly

getting_there.how: One stop via Charlotte, Atlanta or Dallas to Asheville. An Allegiant seasonal nonstop appears on 2025 listings and is unconfirmed for December 2026.
Three family cars from Virginia; one rental for Daniel if he flies.

houses.name: Asheville 12 (The Top Villas)
houses.detail: Six bedrooms including a twin bunk room, five baths, sleeps 16, hot tub, a pool that can be heated for a fee, about 15 minutes from downtown.
houses.price: From $288 a night off-peak; holiday week estimated $900 to $1,500 a night, unquoted; verifiers put the week at $11,000 to $20,000
houses.verdict: The lead. Quote first and ask about Christmas-week minimums.

houses.price: Not retrieved; estimate $900 to $1,500 a night

New Year's Eve chef dinner at the house.

agenda.relax: River Arts District and a long lunch for whoever stays.
